premise: I'm the strongest sorcerer alive. Nobody has ever beaten me. I teach at a school for young sorcerers in modern Tokyo.

bible.title: The Undefeated Apex
bible.era: Modern Tokyo: high-speed trains, smartphones, neon lights, and hidden sorcery

extraordinary.reach: Bending space, manipulating elements, and deploying absolute domains.

peoples.name: Human
peoples.culture: Modern metropolitan Japanese society combined with secretive clan traditions.

creatures.name: Cursed Spirit
creatures.description: Monstrous entities born from the pooled negative emotions of humanity.
creatures.habitat: Dark alleys, abandoned buildings, and subterranean tunnels beneath Tokyo.
creatures.worth: Cursed cores used for crafting magical grade weapons.

rungs.name: Third Grade
rungs.description: Capable students who can handle minor spirits.

rungs.name: First Grade
rungs.description: The elite guard who lead the society.

rungs.name: Special Grade
rungs.description: Anomalies of immense power, capable of taking on entire armies.

travel.description: Sorcerers use the Tokyo subway system, bullet trains, or private tactical sedans.

medicine.healing: Advanced modern hospitals supplemented by specialized positive-energy reverse sorcery.

laws.text: Revealing magic to a non-sorcerer is strictly forbidden and punishable by exile or execution.

rules.text: The existence of sorcery must be kept hidden from ordinary citizens to maintain public order.
The strongest sorcerer possesses power that defies natural laws, but even they cannot resurrect the dead.
Sorcery: real, and hidden from most people.

mysteries.question: Who is sabotaging the ancient barriers protecting Tokyo?
mysteries.answer: An extremist faction within the Sorcerer Council, seeking to trigger a crisis to force a return to militaristic traditionalism.
clues: Traces of a rare Council-exclusive barrier-dissolving ink found at the Shibuya seal site.
A suspicious directive from the Council delaying the reinforcement of the city's defenses.

player.name: Shinji Gojo
player.description: An effortlessly handsome, cool, and laid-back young man who radiates an aura of absolute confidence.
player.appearance: Tall, lean build, with messy silver hair falling over dark glasses. Wearing a customized dark-blue high-collared teacher's uniform.

skills.name: Spatial Sorcery
skills.notes: Absolute command over the space surrounding you.

skills.name: Hand-to-Hand Combat
skills.notes: Unmatched speed and precision in close quarters.

traits.name: Undefeated
traits.description: A profound psychological edge; you have never known defeat, and others feel the weight of your unbroken streak.

traits.name: Playful Detachment
traits.description: Because no threat can truly harm you, you rarely take tense situations seriously.

powers.name: Spatial Infinity Barrier
powers.description: You bring the concept of infinity into reality, creating an invisible barrier that slows down any incoming attack infinitely, preventing it from ever touching you.
limits: Requires passive subconscious concentration to filter non-harmful elements like air and light.

powers.name: Vacuum Spatial Collapse
powers.description: You pinch space together, creating a localized singularity of immense destructive force that pulls in and crushes anything in its path.
limits: Causes brief visual distortion in the surrounding area.

costs.text: Requires a brief moment of hand-sign focus.

temperament.voice: Casual, teasing, and effortlessly relaxed, even in the face of immense danger.

backstory.text: Born into an era of rising cursed spirits, your awakening to spatial sorcery shattered all records of magical potential.
After easily defeating every challenger, rival, and curse that came your way, you found the traditional sorcery world stifling and took a job teaching to foster a new generation of allies.

principal-masamune.name: Principal Masamune
principal-masamune.description: A stern, traditionalist veteran sorcerer who deeply respects your unmatched power but constantly stresses over your unorthodox teaching methods.
principal-masamune.appearance: A tall man in his fifties with graying hair slicked back, wearing a formal high-collared black dark uniform.

wants: Keep the conservative Council off the school's back

akari-sato.name: Akari Sato
akari-sato.description: An exceptionally talented, hot-headed student who is determined to learn your secrets and eventually challenge you to a duel.
akari-sato.appearance: A short, athletic teenager with bright dyed-red hair, wearing a heavily customized academy uniform with combat boots.

tokyo-academy-faction.name: Tokyo Jujutsu Academy
tokyo-academy-faction.description: An elite institution dedicated to training the next generation of sorcerers to defend humanity.

sorcerer-council.name: The Sorcerer Council
sorcerer-council.description: An ancient, highly conservative governing body that regulates all sorcerers across Japan.

tokyo-academy.name: Tokyo Jujutsu Academy
tokyo-academy.description: A sprawling, traditional wooden estate hidden behind a powerful optical illusion barrier in the forested hills of western Tokyo.

tokyo-academy-courtyard.name: Academy Courtyard
tokyo-academy-courtyard.description: A gravel-lined open space framed by ancient cherry blossom trees, used for student assembly and training.

shibuya-district.name: Shibuya District
shibuya-district.description: A neon-drenched, bustling commercial hub of Tokyo, teeming with crowds, underground clubs, and occasional hidden curses.

tokyo-region.name: Tokyo
tokyo-region.description: The massive, sprawling metropolis of Tokyo, blending ultra-modern high-rises with ancient shrines.

fact-1.text: You are the strongest sorcerer alive, possessing absolute spatial manipulation techniques that have kept you completely undefeated.

fact-2.text: The Tokyo Jujutsu Academy is currently experiencing a strange uptick in cursed spirit activity, linked to deteriorating underground seals.

the-undefeated-streak.title: Maintaining the Legend
the-undefeated-streak.stakes: The balance of power in the sorcery world relies on your absolute invincibility.

investigating-the-seal.title: The Decaying Seals
investigating-the-seal.stakes: Preventing a massive catastrophe in the middle of Tokyo.

shibuya-seal-collapse.name: The Shibuya Seal Decay
steps: Unusual spirit sightings spike in the Shibuya subway stations.
Magical wards surrounding the central district begin to crack and flicker.
A localized spatial rift opens, pouring out ancient, hostile cursed spirits.
The Shibuya District is consumed by a massive barrier, trapping thousands inside with high-grade curses.

event-1.title: The Shibuya Seal Decay: Unusual spirit sightings spike in the Shibuya subway stations.

positions: leaning casually against an ancient cherry blossom tree
standing on the gravel path with her arms crossed
props: a warm cup of canned coffee
scene.ended_on: Akari crosses her arms and waits for your response while the subtle disturbance in the wards fades.

state.summary: As the strongest sorcerer alive, you balance teaching young initiates at the Tokyo Jujutsu Academy with maintaining your undefeated legend. However, a mysterious degradation of the ancient wards beneath Shibuya threatens to plunge Tokyo into chaos.

scenes.narration:
Morning sunlight filters through the gnarled branches of ancient cherry blossom trees, casting dappled shadows across the gravel path of the Tokyo Jujutsu Academy courtyard. You lean casually against a thick trunk, silver hair falling over your dark sunglasses as you take a relaxed sip of warm canned coffee. Before you stands Akari Sato, her bright dyed-red hair practically glowing in the morning light. She crosses her arms over her customized uniform, tapping a combat boot impatiently.

"Just one sparring match, Gojo-sensei!" she demands, her competitive spirit burning. "I want to see if I can even graze that invisible barrier of yours."

Before you can tease your hot-headed student, a sudden, cold shiver ripples through the air. The ancient wards protecting the Academy grounds flicker, just for a fraction of a second, before stabilizing. Something is definitely wrong with the seals beneath Tokyo, but Akari is still staring at you, waiting for your answer.

choices: Accept her challenge to show her the gap between your strengths.
Tease her playfully and finish your canned coffee first.
Decline the match to investigate the flickering academy barrier.
